title: Re-run mana tapping analysis with 20+ games at harness epoch 10
description:
Precondition: at least 20 exported games at harness epoch 10+ in website/public/games/.

Epoch 10 introduced the flat mana_plan format (list of strings instead of objects) and multi-ability land support (:N ability index syntax). Games from earlier epochs used the old object format and couldn't use multi-ability lands in mana plans, so they aren't comparable.

Once we have 20+ epoch-10 games, re-run the mana tapping analysis script:

  uv run python scripts/analysis/mana_tapping.py website/public/games/

Filter to games with harness_epoch >= 10. Report findings on:
- How often LLMs use mana_plan vs auto_tap
- mana_plan success/failure rate by model
- Whether models use the :N ability index syntax for dual lands
- Whether certain models should default to auto_tap
- Whether mana_plan is worth keeping or should be simplified/removed

Include the findings in the PR description and update this issue accordingly.
resolution:
Analysis complete with 108 games at epoch >= 10. Key findings:

1. mana_plan dominates: 87% of mana payment actions use mana_plan (4348) vs auto_tap (646). Overall 89% success rate.

2. Strong mana_plan models (95%+): GPT-5-nano (97%), GPT-5.2 (97%), GPT-5-mini (96%), Gemini-3-flash (96%), Claude Sonnet 4.5 (96%), O3 (95%).

3. Weak mana_plan models (<50%): grok-4-fast (7%), llama-4-maverick (20%), kimi-k2-0905 (25%), deepseek-v3.2 (29%), minimax-m2.1 (41%), qwen3-235b (48%). These should default to auto_tap.

4. :N ability index syntax: 13% of mana_plan entries use it (410/3182). Gemini-3-flash (49%) and Llama-4-maverick (50%) use it most; many models (GPT-5-mini, GPT-5-nano, minimax) never use it.

5. Top failure reasons: wrong action state (sending mana_plan when not casting), stale permanent IDs, sending both mana_plan and auto_tap simultaneously.

6. Recommendation: Keep mana_plan — it works excellently for top models. Consider defaulting weak models to auto_tap.
